about.heading: About me
about.paragraph1: Hi, I am Iballa, a Registered Dietitian and proud member of the Irish Nutrition and Dietetics Institute and CORU.
about.paragraph2: I hold a BSc in Biomedical Science from the Technological University of Dublin and an MSc in Human Nutrition and Dietetics from the University of Limerick. Over the past several years, I have gained extensive clinical experience in both Ireland and Australia, working across a wide range of specialties with inpatients and outpatients. This diverse background has allowed me to strengthen my skills and broaden my expertise in supporting people with different nutritional needs.
about.paragraph3: I am deeply passionate about the role of nutrition in health and wellbeing. My approach focuses on educating and empowering individuals to make informed, sustainable choices that truly benefit their health.
about.paragraph4: I don’t believe in strict meal plans or quick fixes like “magic shakes.” Instead, my goal is to equip my clients with the knowledge and confidence to become the experts in their own health—helping them take control, feel empowered, and live their best lives.

appointments.startHere: Not sure which service you need? Start here.
appointments.mealPlanNote: Meal plans are not included in consultations. Instead, you will receive the tools, knowledge and support to eat flexibly in a way that supports your health.
appointments.missingFreeCallUrl: This free-call booking link will be available once the Calendly URL has been added.
policy: Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge with at least 24 hours' notice.
Cancellations within 24 hours of the appointment time, or missed appointments, will be charged in full.

If you are running more than 10 minutes late, we may need to mark the appointment as a no-show. This is simply to make sure we have enough time together to give you the full attention and support you deserve, and to provide you with the best possible service.
We really appreciate your understanding, as it helps us keep availability open for other clients.

freeCall.title: Free 15-minute discovery call
description: Curious if we're a good fit? Book a free, no-pressure discovery call where we'll chat about your health goals, current challenges, and what working together could look like.
This call is a conversation, not a consultation, so come as you are!

initial.title: Initial Consultation
initial.description: 55 minutes — In your first appointment, we’ll review your health history, current medications, previous test results, and eating habits. This will help me understand your situation in a comprehensive way and create a nutrition plan tailored to your needs and goals.

review.title: Review Appointment
review.description: 30 minutes — In the follow-up appointments, we’ll assess your progress and look for solutions to any challenges that may arise along the way.

bundle4.title: Bundle of 4 Consultations
bundle4.description: A discounted way to book multiple consultations and keep consistent support in place.

bundle6.title: Bundle of 6 Consultations
bundle6.description: A discounted option for ongoing nutrition support across several appointments.

items.title: Her work goes far beyond nutrition alone
items.review:
I honestly couldn't be happier with my experience. From day one, she made me feel heard, understood, and supported. What I appreciate most is how she takes the time to adapt everything to my individual needs rather than using a one-size-fits-all approach.

Her work goes far beyond nutrition alone. She takes a truly holistic approach to wellbeing, considering not just food, but also lifestyle, habits, balance, and overall health. That has made a huge difference for me. Thanks Iballa

items.title: A true professional
items.review: A true professional, she taught me how to maintain a balanced diet over time. A true professional. After my digestive diagnosis, she's helping me establish guidelines to improve without drastic restrictions, combining them with basic nutritional advice. I'm delighted!

She showed me the benefits of each food and how to incorporate them into every meal for healthy eating.

Without a doubt, a professional nutritionist with extensive experience.
